536-a-footnote-to-history-eight-years-of.title: A Footnote To History Eight Years Of Trouble In Samoa
536-a-footnote-to-history-eight-years-of.creator: Robert Louis Stevenson
536-a-footnote-to-history-eight-years-of.description: A book by Robert Louis Stevenson. They are Christians, church-goers, singers of hymns at family worship, hardy cricketers; their books are printed in London by Spottiswoode, Trubner, or the Tract Society; but in most other points they are the contemporaries of our tattooed ancestors who drove their chariots on the wrong side of the Roman wall. We have passed the feudal system; they are not yet clear of the patriarchal.

arxiv-1406-6349.title: A comment on “Interlayer interactions in graphites” [Chen et al., Sci. Rep. 3, 3046 (2013)]
arxiv-1406-6349.creator: Tim Gould, Tomáš Bučko, Sébastien Lebègue
arxiv-1406-6349.description: A 2014 arXiv research paper by Tim Gould, Tomáš Bučko, Sébastien Lebègue. Determining the material properties of layered systems like graphite and bigraphene from ab initio calculations is very difficult. This is mostly due to the complex van der Waals forces which help bind the layers. Recently, Chen et al. Chen2013 reported a novel approach for extracting geometry dependent energetic properties of general, layered graphitic systems from periodic graphite calculations on AA, AB and ABC graphite.

arxiv-2108-12496.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Jorge Gaona Universidad Metropolitana de Ciencias de la Educación Email: jorge.gaona@umce.cl, Romina Menares Universidad de Valparaíso Email: romina.menares@uv.cl. Resumen En este artículo se reporta el trabajo de argumentación de un grupo de profesores de matemáticas en formación en una experimentación realizada en una clase virtual (a causa de la emergencia del COVID-19), durante el 2020. Se trabajó con una tarea sobre fracciones en un sistema de evaluación en línea con preguntas con parámetros aleatorios e infinitas respuestas correctas posibles.

arxiv-2110-07541.title: Leading-Color Two-Loop Amplitudes for Four Partons and a W W Boson in QCD Preprint: CERN-TH-2021-156 FR-PHENO-2021-12 MPP-2021-181
arxiv-2110-07541.creator: S. Abreu, F. Febres Cordero, H. Ita, M. Klinkert, B. Page, and V. Sotnikov
arxiv-2110-07541.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by S. Abreu, F. Febres Cordero, H. Ita, M. Klinkert, B. Page, and V. Sotnikov. We present the leading-color two-loop QCD corrections for the scattering of four partons and a W W boson, including its leptonic decay. The amplitudes are assembled from the planar two-loop helicity amplitudes for four partons and a vector boson decaying to a lepton pair, which are also used to determine the planar two-loop amplitudes for four partons and a Z / γ ∗ Z/\gamma^{*} boson with a leptonic decay.

britannica-1911-albany-dukes-of.title: Albany, Dukes of (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-albany-dukes-of.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-albany-dukes-of.description: Article 'Albany, Dukes of' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 1), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. Robert Stewart, duke of Albany (c. 1345–1420), regent of Scotland, was a son of King Robert II. by his mistress, Elizabeth Mure, and was legitimatized when his parents were married about 1349. In 1361 he married Margaret, countess of Menteith, and after his widowed sister-in-law, Isabel, countess of Fife, had recognized him as her heir, he was known as the earl of Fife and Menteith.

Three different O/W emulsions were prepared using MP, MP + CPI complex, or MP + DBD-treated CPI complex as the emulsifier.

pmc-11405926.title: Evaluation serum soluble interleukin 2 receptor with diagnosis and prognosis in canine solid tumour: 34 cases
pmc-11405926.creator: Hyun NamKung, Su‐Min Park, Jae‐Hyeon Im, Ga‐Hyun Lim, Min‐Ok Ryu, Kyoung‐Won Seo, Hwa‐Young Youn
pmc-11405926.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background/AimThe soluble interleukin‐2 receptor (sIL‐2R) serve as a valuable biomarker for tumors in human patients, as its levels increase during the activation of T lymphocytes in clinical states such as inflammation, infection, and tumor. This study aimed to demonstrate that sIL‐2R levels can be also elevated in dogs with tumors and evaluate its applicability as a diagnostic and prognostic factor in canine cancer patients.Patients and MethodsSerum was collected from 6 healthy dogs and 34 dogs with solid tumors.

pmc-11491376.title: Enhancing learning experiences: EEG-based passive BCI system adapts learning speed to cognitive load in real-time, with motivation as catalyst
pmc-11491376.creator: Noémie Beauchemin, Patrick Charland, Alexander Karran, Jared Boasen, Bella Tadson, Sylvain Sénécal, Pierre-Majorique Léger
pmc-11491376.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Computer-based learning has gained popularity in recent years, providing learners greater flexibility and freedom. However, these learning environments do not consider the learner’s mental state in real-time, resulting in less optimized learning experiences. This research aimed to explore the effect on the learning experience of a novel EEG-based Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) that adjusts the speed of information presentation in real-time during a learning task according to the learner’s cognitive load. We also explored how motivation moderated these effects.

pmc-11714464.title: Supporting Aging through Green Exercise (SAGE): Comparing the cognitive effects of outdoor versus indoor aerobic exercise in older adults with mild cognitive impairment—A 12‐week proof‐of‐concept randomized controlled trial
pmc-11714464.creator: Matt W Noseworthy, Nathan Wei, Sofia Grant, Jammy Zou, Eli Puterman, Todd C Handy, Teresa Liu‐Ambrose
pmc-11714464.description: BackgroundEvidence from randomized controlled trials (RCTs) shows that aerobic exercise (AE) can benefit cognitive function among older adults with mild cognitive impairment (MCI). Growing research suggests that outdoor, natural (i.e., “green”) environments, compared with indoor or built environments, may augment the health benefits of exercise. However, the potential cognitive benefits of green exercise are unclear.

pmc-12432167.title: LncRNA EUDAL shapes tumor cell response to hypoxia-induced constitutive EGFR activation and promotes chemoresistance in oral cancer
pmc-12432167.creator: Shengkai Chen, Zhenlin Dai, Jianbo Shi, Mengyu Rui, Zhiyuan Zhang, Qin Xu
pmc-12432167.description: Hypoxia and aberrant activation of epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) are considered important features of various malignancies. However, whether hypoxia can directly trigger EGFR activation and its clinical implications remain unclear. In this study, we demonstrated that in oral cancer, a typical hypoxic tumor, hypoxia can induce chronic but constitutive phosphorylation of wild-type EGFR in the absence of ligands.

pmc-12466041.title: A Scalable, Multi-format Approach to Polypharmacy Education in Rural Older Adults: An Exploratory Pilot Study Comparing Self-Paced Packet Versus In-Person Education Interventions
pmc-12466041.creator: Caleb Zimmerman, Aditya Shah, Patrick Fakhoury, Christya Haddad, Keira Tolmie, Erin Williams, Jyotsna Pandey
pmc-12466041.description: BackgroundPolypharmacy poses significant risks for older adults, especially in rural areas where healthcare access may be limited. This exploratory pilot study assessed the feasibility and potential impact of two educational interventions aimed at supporting medication management among rural older adults.MethodologyWe conducted a comparative intervention study from July 2024 to October 2024.

pmc-12522183.title: Circular RNA hsa_circ_0000118 promotes atrial fibrosis by regulating the microRNA-34a-5p/Smad4 axis
pmc-12522183.creator: Na Wu, Yuanbo Zhang, Yuhong Zeng, Lanqing Yang, Jun Li, Yanxiu Chen, Zhiquan Yuan, Xinghua Chen, Chengying Li, Long Wu, Tongjian Cai, Zhihui Zhang, Li Zhong, Yafei Li
pmc-12522183.description: The regulatory functions and underlying mechanisms of circular RNAs (circRNAs/circs) in atrial fibrillation (AF) are largely unknown. The present study aimed to assess the prognostic roles and potential biological functions of hsa_circ_0000118 in structural remodeling in AF. Gain- and loss-of-function cell models were established in mouse cardiac fibroblasts.

pmc-13068327.title: Household and community-based approaches to malaria and cholera prevention: A narrative review with case studies from Uganda and Mozambique
pmc-13068327.creator: Giacomo Guido, Valentina Totaro, Peter Lochoro, Jerry Ictho, Edoardo Occa, Kajal Chhaganlal, Francesco Vladimiro Segala, Giovanni Dall’Oglio, Braunde Francisco Mechendura, Elmano Gomonda, Giovanni Putoto, Federica Penco, Muhammad Asaduzzaman, Emanuele Nicastri, Ferenc Balázs Farkas, Roberta Iatta, B
pmc-13068327.description: BackgroundHousing conditions play a fundamental role in infectious diseases transmission, particularly in endemic regions. Structural modifications to homes—such as screened windows and doors, sealed eaves, elevated flooring, and insecticide-treated barriers—are increasingly recognized as key strategies for reducing mosquito entry and, consequently, malaria risk.

pmc-13188249.title: POU2F1 drives cholesterol biosynthesis and lipid remodeling through the DHCR24/ELOVL2 axis in endometrial cancer
pmc-13188249.creator: Zi-hui Zhang, Fei-fei Yuan, Lian Yang, Wei Zhang, Shuang Li, Yu-qin Huang
pmc-13188249.description: Endometrial cancer (EC) is characterized by metabolic reprogramming, with cholesterol biosynthesis playing a critical role. However, the upstream transcriptional regulation of this process requires further elucidation. In this study, we identified POU2F1 as a key oncogenic transcription factor that drives cholesterol biosynthesis and tumor progression in EC.
